biggest_catch: dscout publishes no participant pay terms or payment timing anywhere official — the only official number is a single blog example of a two-week mission.
catches: No official participant terms page stating pay rates or payment deadlines.
The one official example is a 14-day, 3-part Diary mission — multi-week, not same-day.
Third-party claims ($15–$100/mission, PayPal after ~10 business days) were excluded as unofficial.
